# Pricing Ladder

Three plans, each a step up in seats and support.

| Plan    | Seats | Monthly | Annual (per month) |
|---------|------:|--------:|-------------------:|
| Starter | 3     | $49     | $41                |
| Studio  | 10    | $129    | $107               |
| Firm    | 40    | $399    | $332               |

Upgrades happen when a firm adds its fourth bookkeeper. See
[[Move to Annual Billing|the annual billing decision]] and
[[Sunset the Free Tier]].
